scripts.BUILD:LIBS: ng build tool-config-to-lib-ang15 && ng build tool-dom-ang15 && ng build tool-exchange-ang15 && ng build tool-page-ang15 && ng build tool-screen-ang15 && ng build tool-width-page-ang15
scripts.PROD-HTTP: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ip = (Get-NetIPAddress | Where-Object { $_.AddressFamily -eq 'IPv4' -and $_.PrefixOrigin -eq 'Dhcp' }).IPAddress; $url = 'http://' + $ip + ':4343'; Write-Host ('Access on: ' + $url); Start-Job { Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; Start-Process $args[0] } -ArgumentList $url | Out-Null; ng serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4343"
scripts.PUBLISH:config: npm --prefix projects/tool-config-to-lib-ang15 version patch --no-git-tag-version && ng build tool-config-to-lib-ang15 && npm publish ./dist/tool-config-to-lib-ang15
scripts.PUBLISH:dom: npm --prefix projects/tool-dom-ang15 version patch --no-git-tag-version && ng build tool-dom-ang15 && npm publish ./dist/tool-dom-ang15
scripts.PUBLISH:exchange: npm --prefix projects/tool-exchange-ang15 version patch --no-git-tag-version && ng build tool-exchange-ang15 && npm publish ./dist/tool-exchange-ang15
scripts.PUBLISH:page: npm --prefix projects/tool-page-ang15 version patch --no-git-tag-version && ng build tool-page-ang15 && npm publish ./dist/tool-page-ang15
scripts.PUBLISH:screen: npm --prefix projects/tool-screen-ang15 version patch --no-git-tag-version && ng build tool-screen-ang15 && npm publish ./dist/tool-screen-ang15
scripts.PUBLISH:width: npm --prefix projects/tool-width-page-ang15 version patch --no-git-tag-version && ng build tool-width-page-ang15 && npm publish ./dist/tool-width-page-ang15
scripts.PUBLISH:ALL: npm run PUBLISH:config && npm run PUBLISH:dom && npm run PUBLISH:exchange && npm run PUBLISH:page && npm run PUBLISH:screen && npm run PUBLISH:width
